request.style: English, female solo, warm and uplifting, piano, strings, soft drums, bass, gentle mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The law was weak within the flesh
God sent his own Son to set us free
In the likeness of sinful nature
He offered up the sacrifice
So the righteous requirement would be met
In us who walk by the Spirit now
Not by the desires of the body
But by the breath of the Holy One

[Chorus]
The mind set on the Spirit is life and peace
A gentle hope that no darkness can erase
The mind set on the Spirit is life and peace
A quiet joy for the weary soul to release

[Verse]
Those who live according to the flesh
Set their minds on what the body wants
But those who live in the Spirit
Set their minds on what the Spirit brings
Hostile thoughts cannot submit to God
They cannot follow his holy law
Those who stay in the flesh
Cannot please the Lord in any way

[Chorus]
The mind set on the Spirit is life and peace
A gentle hope that no darkness can erase
The mind set on the Spirit is life and peace
A quiet joy for the weary soul to release

[Bridge]
But you are not in the flesh today
The Spirit of Christ dwells in you
If you have not the Spirit of Christ
You do not belong to him at all

[Chorus]
The mind set on the Spirit is life and peace
A gentle hope that no darkness can erase
The mind set on the Spirit is life and peace
A quiet joy for the weary soul to release

[Outro]
The mind set on the Spirit is life and peace
Resting in the truth of his love
